mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the definition of functions in an organisation and their arrangement into a total pattern."
Formal structure means the definition of functions in an organisation and their arrangement into a total pattern.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the umbrella organisation in which the executive arm of government utilises to implement the rules and regulations as made by the legislatures."
The civil service is the umbrella organisation in which the executive arm of government utilises to implement the rules and regulations as made by the legislatures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a publicly-owned corporation, which manages public resources and is subject to mechanism of accountability."
A public enterprise is a publicly-owned corporation, which manages public resources and is subject to mechanism of accountability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a career to which the public servants can devote their time and energy until they attain retirement age."
The public service is a career to which the public servants can devote their time and energy until they attain retirement age.
fib: ______ is the most significant and integral part of administration.
Organisation is the most significant and integral part of administration.

______ is responsible for managing all the policy decisions of the organisation, but the implementation of policies and the day-to-day operation of the organisation are carried out by the managing director.

The policy board is responsible for managing all the policy decisions of the organisation, but the implementation of policies and the day-to-day operation of the organisation are carried out by the managing director.
______ means government selling part or whole shares owned by it in public enterprises to individuals or institutions.
Privatisation means government selling part or whole shares owned by it in public enterprises to individuals or institutions.
